sql: select line from public.ai_agent_settings s, regexp_split_to_table(coalesce(s.extra_instructions,''), E'\n') as line where s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and (line ilike '%tradição%' or line ilike '%4.000%' or line ilike '%google%' or line ilike '%apresent%' or line ilike '%primeira%' or line ilike '%Bia%')
